name: editorial-drop-cap
title: Editorial Drop Cap
description: A true initial letter: the first character sits in a measured float spanning a fixed number of text lines, with a hanging indent recomputed from the glyph's actual advance width, not a guessed ch value.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Asymmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
